bullets: Added GPT-6 Luna to the free model picker, replacing GPT-5.6 Luna as the selectable free option for new sessions.
Added a baseline x64 build for older Intel Macs without AVX2 to the Freebuff launcher, with automatic fallback after a failed launch.
Replaced mechanical history pruning with model-based context compaction that summarizes history through a dedicated tool.
Added a fallback to the mechanical compaction pass when model-based compaction fails, logging a content-free event without aborting the run.
Added bounds on tool results so they fit within a quarter of the model context budget, replacing previous token-count based limits.
Added an assert on user content size so oversized inputs are rejected before entering the agent step loop.
Added Space Bunny Alpha to the Freebuff model catalog as a full-access, multimodal model priced at 10 Freebucks with high reasoning.
Added Solar Mini 4 to the Freebuff model catalog, replacing Solar Pro 4 on the OpenRouter discounted price-override lane.
Updated sponsorship tier notices and subscription disclaimers to name GPT-6 Luna instead of GPT-5.6 Luna.
Removed the referral signup limit constant, lifting the hard cap on referred free sessions while keeping daily reward limits.
Updated the free model downgrade logic so previously banned foreign toolsets are rechecked before final admission.
Changed sponsored compute campaign admission to accept either all campaigns or an explicit listed set of UUID-formatted IDs.
Updated the Sponsored Compute policy so malformed wildcard values close admission instead of widening it.
Added a suggested Git identity to Sponsored Git setup previews, resolved from global then system config or a default fallback.
Added parsing of the free-mode session slowed SSE notice so SDK listeners can observe pacing delays in real time.
Updated the BYOK fetch wrapper to return a dedicated model-id rejection error message for unrecognized model IDs.
Added two privacy decision outcomes so the server can flag egress as suspicious without blocking it.
